Review every outgoing commit, not only the final working tree.
Review editor process execution, filesystem access and workspace trust boundaries.
Check diagnostics and exported project configuration for private paths and user content.

resource_contracts.description: Owns document snapshots, selections, revisions, persistence, file switching, and workspace document caches.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: Document text copies must be tied to immutable revisions or explicit replace operations; repeated full copies require UI and memory justification.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Async loads and saves must carry generation or revision guards so stale completions cannot overwrite active state.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Missing documents, failed stores, and absent selections must produce explicit seed, failed, or unchanged states.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Document caches and listeners must be invalidated when workspace, path, or active document changes.

state_machine.source: DocumentState, editor controller tests, workspace store tests, and shell model tests.

transitions.on: store returns existing or seeded document

invalid_operations: stale async load overwrites active document

required_tests: editor controller editing tests for document mutation
workspace document store tests for persistence behavior
shell model tests for async load or file switching changes
required_gates: cd frontend/styio_view_app && flutter test test/editor_controller_editing_test.dart test/workspace_document_store_test.dart

resource_contracts.description: Owns local, hosted, and web adapter commands, execution sessions, toolchain/dependency/deployment result states, and capability routing.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: Adapter payloads and hosted responses must have size limits or summarized machine payloads before buffering.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Commands must expose running, terminal, cancellation, and blocked states without overlapping writes to shared workspace state.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Unavailable routes, missing binaries, network failures, and unsupported capabilities must be normalized to blocked or failed results.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Temporary overlays, subprocesses, HTTP clients, and streams must be released after success, failure, timeout, and cancellation.

state_machine.source: Adapter result enums, execution session types, model tests, product workflow tests, and hosted/local adapter tests.

transitions.on: adapter returns failure or exception is normalized

invalid_operations: invoking adapter before route capability is checked
letting adapter exceptions escape shell model
leaving execution overlay mutable against source workspace

required_tests: adapter unit tests for touched command result type
hosted/local product workflow test when execution route changes
negative tests for timeout, missing binary, and failed response paths
required_gates: STYIO_VIEW_PRODUCT_GATE=1 cd frontend/styio_view_app && flutter test test/local_product_workflow_test.dart test/hosted_product_workflow_test.dart

resource_contracts.description: Owns module manifests, capability matrices, staged updates, optional uninstall policy, platform visibility, and module enablement state.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: Module manifests and capability matrices should be loaded once into stable immutable summaries unless tests justify reload behavior.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Module lifecycle changes must define staging and commit boundaries so UI reads do not observe partial updates.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Missing manifests, unsupported platforms, and optional modules must produce declared blocked or unavailable states.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Optional uninstall and staged update cleanup must define package, cache, and data retention behavior.

state_machine.source: Module lifecycle types, manifest assets, capability matrices, module lifecycle tests, and platform runbooks.

transitions.on: platform and dependency gates allow use

required_tests: module lifecycle tests for manifest and update policy changes
capability matrix fixture test when platform visibility changes
integration gate before real package/cache deletion behavior is claimed

resource_contracts.description: Owns runtime event envelopes, replay summaries, graph summaries, debug lanes, filters, and UI-facing runtime status.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: Runtime event lists must be summarized or windowed before repeated UI transformations on large traces.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Runtime replay updates must preserve event order and avoid stale summaries after route changes.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Empty event streams, missing terminal nodes, and absent detail labels must have explicit empty or unknown states.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Replay windows, debug filters, and route summaries must clear or recompute when execution sessions change.

state_machine.source: Runtime summary types, runtime surface tests, hosted payload codec tests, and shell model runtime state.

transitions.on: lanes and graph details are computed

required_tests: runtime surface tests for summary and UI behavior
hosted payload codec tests for runtime event payload changes
shell model tests when execution route changes runtime state
required_gates: cd frontend/styio_view_app && flutter test test/runtime_surfaces_test.dart test/hosted_payload_codec_test.dart

security_boundaries: Authentication and authorization implementation may be public for local, hosted, and web adapter protocol behavior.
Privacy and PII payloads must not be committed in UI fixtures, hosted payload examples, reports, or logs.
Password storage is not a production styio-view responsibility; any password fixture must be fake test data.
Secret, token, key, and credential material such as hosted access tokens must come from runtime configuration and stay private.
Production private material, tokens, certificates, and generated key bundles are offline or not committed to GitHub.
Permission matrix and route authorization behavior for local, hosted, and web adapter calls must be covered by regression tests.
Deployment security config must document TLS, CORS, CSRF, cookie, debug exposure, and hosted-control-plane boundaries where applicable.
SBOM, CVE, and dependency vulnerability scan evidence is required before release or external deployment gates pass.
DAST black-box penetration security regression must cover hosted adapter and development server HTTP surfaces before public deployment.
Runtime secret manager or KMS key rotation owns hosted access tokens, certificates, and production credentials.
Rate limit, anti replay nonce, and idempotency boundaries must be documented for hosted adapter and development server routes.
Log redaction and audit log rules must prevent hosted tokens, request payloads, and credentials from being written to logs.
SSRF egress allowlist and URL allowlist boundaries must cover hosted backend calls and any outbound preview or adapter requests.
Command execution must use subprocess allowlists and reject shell injection surfaces for local toolchain and prototype helpers.
